incident_text: Replies on WhatsApp are taking many minutes to arrive since about 09:45 UTC. Answers are correct when they come.

changes.title: refactor: build the tool registry with dict()
changes.author: ananya

truth.description: Someone set the worker Lambda's reserved concurrency to 1 from the console; one slot cannot keep up with ~24 messages/min at ~3s each, so SQS inbound backs up and replies wait minutes.

trap: A worker deploy lands four minutes earlier; the real change is a console configuration change (CloudTrail), not in git and only visible with kinds=config.
